Usage: spec-driven-steroids inject [options]

Inject platform-specific Spec-Driven configs

Options:
  --platform <ids>      Comma-separated platform IDs (skips the platform
                        prompt)
  --scope <scope>       Injection scope: global or project
  --templates <source>  Template source: bundled or remote
  --dry-run             Show planned files without writing them
  --json                Emit a machine-readable JSON summary
  --backup              Back up existing platform roots before writing
  --yes                 Skip prompts when --platform is provided
  -h, --help            display help for command
